# logcut v1.0.0

## Changes

- Mark the current CLI, options, environment variables, exit-code behavior, and profiles as the first stable public compatibility contract.
- Publish Linux x86_64 and ARM64 GNU/glibc binaries as the v1.0.0 release.

## Compatibility

- Existing commands, profiles, and retention settings are unchanged.
- Future changes follow Semantic Versioning.
